name: team_stop
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: Stop a member of your team, and the members under it, where they are: their work stops and they leave the team, which makes room for others. Only members under you, directly or through your members; `all` stops every one of them. Nothing they had not reported comes back — ask for a report with team_send first when you need it.

name.description: A member under you, or all
